lastTask: Spike connector-first starter songs with edit/regenerate/clone controls

projectState.summary: The full-form starter branch was parked after Arne's listening feedback that it sounded like a longer algorithmic pattern rather than a cohesive song. Current branch codex/byte-connector-song-spike-a changes starter-generated melody material to a sparse AnchorPhrase with seven anchors and five dense connectors rendered through renderAnchorPhrase, so connector notes carry most of the movement while the existing in-scale transport path stays unchanged. Song library controls now include Edit, Regen, and Clone: Edit reopens a stored starter; Regen creates a fresh materialSeed on the same song and refreshes lookahead; Clone creates a versioned copy. Prompt/player text can mark blue/chromatic/glide intent in connector metadata, but true non-modal/continuous pitch is still a carry-forward because PatternNoteSource resolves integer modal scaleDegree. Validation: npm run build, focused song-library smoke, npm run smoke (78/78), npm run db:smoke, git diff --check all green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
